nodes.description: State variable whaleSharkContract of type WhaleSharkContract, used to query shark balances.
State variable stakingContract of type StakingContract, used to query staked tokens.
CollabMux.balanceOf(address owner) public view returns total sharks held and staked.
Abstract WhaleSharkContract.balanceOf(address) view returns shark balance.
Abstract StakingContract.getTokensStaked(address) view returns StakingInfo array.
External call to whaleSharkContract.balanceOf(owner) returning uint256.
External call to stakingContract.getTokensStaked(owner) returning StakingInfo array.
Parameter owner of CollabMux.balanceOf, address to query balances for.
Local variable numStaked storing length of stakingContract.getTokensStaked(owner).

edges.reason: owner parameter is passed into the balanceOf function.
whaleSharkContract state variable is used as the target of the external call.
owner parameter is passed as argument to the external call whaleSharkContract.balanceOf.
Return value of external call is assigned to local variable numHoldingSharks.
stakingContract state variable is used as the target of the external call.
owner parameter is passed as argument to the external call stakingContract.getTokensStaked.
Length of the external call result is assigned to local variable numStaked.
numHoldingSharks is an operand of the addition operation.
numStaked is an operand of the addition operation.
Result of the addition is returned by the balanceOf function.
balanceOf executes the external call to whaleSharkContract.balanceOf.
balanceOf executes the external call to stakingContract.getTokensStaked.
External call invokes the abstract WhaleSharkContract.balanceOf function.
External call invokes the abstract StakingContract.getTokensStaked function.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter owner belongs to the CollabMux.balanceOf function and should be merged into it.
Local numHoldingSharks directly stores the result of the external call to whaleSharkContract.balanceOf, so merge into that unsafe operation.
Local numStaked directly stores the length of the external call to stakingContract.getTokensStaked, so merge into that unsafe operation.
